meta.source: ACLED (Armed Conflict Location & Event Data), Nigeria — monthly events and fatalities by LGA, via HDX (nigeria-acled-conflict-data)
meta.join: ACLED Admin2 P-code ↔ OCHA COD-AB NGA admin-2 (HDX cod-ab-nga, CC BY-IGO); site → LGA by point-in-polygon; area = LGAs whose polygon is within the radius
meta.licence: ACLED Terms of Use & Attribution Policy (attribution required; public aggregates used for non-commercial monitoring — confirm before commercial reuse). Boundaries: OCHA COD-AB, CC BY-IGO.
meta.attribution: Armed Conflict Location & Event Data (ACLED); www.acleddata.com
meta.caveat: Event counts are reported conflict events, not a risk judgement. LGA aggregates include every event in an LGA that touches the radius, so the area figures overstate what lies strictly within it. Civilian targeting is a subset of political violence.
